requirements: All battery (DC) smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery alarms
Smoke alarms must be less than 10 years old; the realtor, owner, seller or buyer must take each alarm down and check the date

Smoke alarm type and number follow the year the house was built (for example 1991 to present: hardwired alarms with battery backup on each level and in each bedroom, interconnected); hardwired alarms cannot be replaced with a single battery alarm
CO alarm within 10 feet of all sleeping areas if the home has a fuel-burning appliance, fireplace or attached garage

Homes with a secondary power source (solar, generator, battery storage) need a permanent, non-handwritten label at the main electrical panel and electric meter, such as 'Caution: Multiple Sources of Power'
Homes with a low-voltage fire alarm system must have it certified by an alarm contractor before the inspection
Electric power must be on; an adult (18+) must be present for the whole inspection; inspectors do not use lockboxes

Senior discount, 62 or older (proof of age)
fees.quote: Senior Citizen's Discount (62- Or Older Proof of age attached)     $30.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Apply online through the Winslow Township Fire Department resale application, then pay through the Edmunds WIPP payment link; or download the packet and fax it to 609-561-5823; or apply in person at 9 Cedar Brook Road, Sicklerville (9 am to 5 pm weekdays). Pay by check (payable to Winslow Township Fire District), credit card, debit card or money order. Inspections are Tuesdays and Thursdays in a morning or afternoon block. All fees are non-refundable. Certificates are valid 90 days from the inspection date.
